shared_elements: monolithic anthropomorphic figure with block head and squared torso
incised low-relief motifs on the back of the head/upper block
paired arched/curved motifs resembling arms or crescents on the upper back
central ring or disc motif on the lower back
curving band across the lower body suggesting a belt or loincloth
vertical hanging elements below the belt
paired small round bosses flanking the central area
justification: Both show the identical scheme: a massive block-headed anthropomorphic statue whose back bears the same sequence of incised motifs from top to bottom — vertical striations on the head, paired curved crescent/arm forms with small ring bosses, a large central ring, and a belt-like arc with pendant vertical elements below. The correspondence extends to the exact placement and proportion of each motif, so these appear to depict the same object; the only differences are viewing angle and surface condition, which are excluded from consideration.
